text_block_list.text:
Things have never been as fired up here
at the
Takamatsunomiya Kinen as they
are today, folks!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
After catching her breath, Фудзи Кисэки
faces the
crowd and waves.

Thank you, everyone! Your cheers make

everything worth it!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I might not have won this time, but I
have no
intention of stopping!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
My next race will be the Yasuda Kinen,
where the
battleground is in my favor.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I hope you'll be there to witness the
incredible
miracle I'll create!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Gah! It sucks that she didn't win, but
that race
was something else!
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to see how she does in her
next race.
It's amazing how she can make
every race
exciting, whether she wins or
loses.
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text:
I mean, she landed in the top three.
That's a big
win in and of itself! I'd count
it as a victory!
text_block_list.name: Spectator B

text_block_list.text:
Fuji seriously is the best! She was great
as a
classic racer, and I bet things will
only get better
for her!
text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Club Member

text_block_list.text:
News articles celebrating Фудзи Кисэки's

performance at the Takamatsunomiya
Kinen
follow at unstoppable speed.
Videos of the race reach over a million views, and the issue of Twinkle Monthly featuring her is sold out everywhere.

Her rise is now approaching the scale of
a proper
social phenomenon.

Oh, sorry! Yeah, I was just lost in
thought.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
There are reporters here today too,
right? Oof, I
can't be spacing out like
this!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Her next race will be the mile-long
Yasuda Kinen.
As Фудзи Кисэки races down
the turf, flashes from
countless news
cameras follow her.
